caption: Figure 12.3: Longitudinal z-slab MPI domain decomposition (use_mpi=True) and multi-GPU binding. A 3D grid of length N_z is split along z across size MPI ranks (mpiexec -n 4); each rank owns N_z / size interior cells plus a 1-cell ghost halo at its lower and upper z interfaces, exchanged at every half-step via SolverFIT3D.mpi_communicate(). When combined with use_gpu=True, each rank binds to rank % n_gpus via CuPy for both forward time-stepping and multi-rank MPI discrete adjoints (AdjointSimulation).
